closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin C, and sweetness is kept unusually well in check, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein quality, and low omega 3. It is good for immune support and low-calorie volume because vitamin C gives the immune-support side a reason to exist and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
